name: AIdos host
howToReproduce: Zero-shot clone: generate(text, ref_audio=host-reference.wav, ref_text=referenceText), then apply post.
referenceText: Your first mission: find something soft and blue. Ready? Go! Great job! The sky looks blue because tiny bits of air scatter blue light all around.
designedWith: female, teenager, high pitch, american accent

runtime.engine: Kyutai Pocket TTS in the browser (pocket-tts-js, INT8 ONNX, CC-BY-4.0)
runtime.cloneReference: public/voice/host-reference-aidos.mp3 (neutral excerpt of the approved sample, already +3 semitones and x0.85)
runtime.note: Library default 0.7 gives squeaky pitch jumps (8% of voiced frames); 0.3 keeps the 304 Hz median and intonation and drops them to 3.5%. Each line gets 10 ms / 40 ms edge fades against clicks.

edit: Removed the former-brand introduction; retained the same approved voice without resynthesis.
